correctness.rationale: The complete-reset stationary age is exponential. The exact OU excursion representation, rescaled Brownian kernels and uniform heading convergence prove the joint law for each finite thermal balance, while noise rescaling proves the infinite-balance endpoint. Itô covariance has positive determinant for positive balance. Density normalization comes from a Gaussian mixture and its angular far-field follows from a unique nondegenerate saddle with a proven positive second derivative. All 650 reproducible finite checks pass. Finite checks are not substitutes for the proof.
